§ 01 · The Program

Global judgment,
one decision at a time.

From negotiating across cultures and entering emerging markets, to managing currency risk, leading multicultural teams, and navigating international trade regulations, every scenario drops you into a genuine international business situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Thirty-five culture-focused scenarios and sixty-five market-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real global judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation an internationally minded professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across market entry, trade compliance, cross-cultural leadership, and global strategy.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound international business judgment under pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

scenario.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Global Strategy Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping internationally minded professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in global business isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a cross-cultural situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, international roles in English — Mr. Gad International Business is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the global business moments you'll actually face.
